title: Shipaton 2025 winners
description: Catalog of Shipaton 2025 award winners for design study. Public sources only; no endorsement.
disclaimer: Independent design study desk. Citations and store previews do not imply affiliation or endorsement.

winners.name: Payout
winners.oneLiner: Discover class-action settlements you may already qualify for — transparent, automated, and accessible.

winners.name: Gurwi
winners.oneLiner: Learn anything in an easy, visual, interactive way — short modules with images, animations, and questions.

winners.name: Echo Reminder
winners.oneLiner: Speak to capture reminders — voice parsed into titles, times, and repeat schedules.

winners.name: Tomo Japan
winners.oneLiner: A friendly, curated Japan travel companion with destinations, city guides, and local gems.

winners.name: Dayloop
winners.oneLiner: Turn everyday moments into cinematic timelapse videos with auto face alignment — no editing skills required.

winners.name: SkillMe
winners.oneLiner: Learn any skill one daily challenge at a time — personalized plans powered by AI.

winners.name: PitchLab
winners.oneLiner: Professional-grade baseball pitch tracking from a single iPhone camera — velocity, spin, and break.

winners.name: ReadHim
winners.oneLiner: Decode romantic text conversations with data-driven reports on tone, patterns, and red flags.

winners.name: Shutter Declutter
winners.oneLiner: Photo cleanup as a daily ritual — swipe through photos from this date in past years.

winners.name: MemoLune
winners.oneLiner: Jot thoughts as naturally as sending a message — voice, OCR, and chat-like memos.

winners.name: Vector Guard
winners.oneLiner: Identify disease-carrying ticks and mosquitoes with offline CDC data — and fund free access in high-risk ZIPs.

winners.name: Napkinmatic AI3D
winners.oneLiner: Snap a napkin doodle and turn it into digital art, 3D models, and animated videos.

winners.name: Kigaru Talks
winners.oneLiner: Speak Japanese with confidence through real AI conversation — judgment-free fluency practice.

winners.name: Heartbeat Hero
winners.oneLiner: CPR coach on iPhone/iPad — rhythm, depth, AI call simulation, and AED map, mostly offline.

winners.name: Hearing Buddy
winners.oneLiner: Real-time private captions for conversations — on-device speech recognition for hearing challenges.

winners.name: MoodHaven
winners.oneLiner: Help parents track a child’s moods, sleep, medication, and incidents into clear patterns.

winners.name: Otter Day
winners.oneLiner: Learn to name the weekday of any date in history — a story-driven calendar logic game.

winners.name: Dripped
winners.oneLiner: AI stylist for your wardrobe — answer “what should I wear today?” with outfit suggestions.

winners.name: MaestLog
winners.oneLiner: An elegant concert diary for classical music lovers — venues, programs, reflections, ratings.

winners.name: Cooked This
winners.oneLiner: Cooking diary and tracker — log meals, track variety, and celebrate kitchen streaks.

winners.name: Voicetree
winners.oneLiner: AI meeting notes for work and study — record, transcribe, summarize, and chat with transcripts.

winners.name: Friendy+
winners.oneLiner: Capture new contacts and stay in touch — a personal relationship assistant for weak ties.

winners.name: Studient
winners.oneLiner: Turn any PDF into flashcards, quizzes, and summaries — an AI study companion.

winners.name: Camp Notes
winners.oneLiner: Camping journal for site-level notes, photos, ratings, and a crowdsourced campground database.

winners.name: Momental
winners.oneLiner: Minimalist meditation and focus — one page, one tap, customizable soundscapes. No login, no ads.

winners.name: Posturely
winners.oneLiner: Real-time posture coaching via camera and sensors — friendly giraffe mascot, privacy-first.

winners.name: Steps Share
winners.oneLiner: Shared step tracking with live rings and friend duels — fitness that stays social.

winners.name: DrawIt
winners.oneLiner: Multiplatform draw-and-guess party game with real-time rooms and leaderboards.

winners.name: ClipUGC
winners.oneLiner: Create authentic influencer-style hook videos — AI influencers for indie marketing.

winners.name: Crystal Abyss
winners.oneLiner: Columns-like puzzle through Dante’s nine circles — serene minimalism meets jewel cascades.

budgetTripMockups.note: Concept mockups only — not a shipped Shipaton product. Craft patterns borrowed from winners (clarity, modules, itinerary, confidence, report cards) without cloning brands.

nameProposals.name: Outlay
nameProposals.why: Spend-first framing — budget is the constraint, not an afterthought.

nameProposals.name: Nearfar
nameProposals.why: Equal weight for local get-out-of-house and farther trips.

nameProposals.name: Leaveby
nameProposals.why: Date window as the second axis — leave by when, spend at most.
